_comment: Real inputs. STR scenarios anchored to AirROI calculator percentiles for THIS property (4bd/2ba, lat -35.236/lng 149.033), pulled 2026-08-08. Gross revenue is authoritative from AirROI; ADR/occupancy are descriptive. Costs are labelled assumptions you can override.

_sources.airroi_market_district_of_belconnen: occ 47%, ADR $229.6, RevPAR $111.5, avg annual revenue $28,188, ~196 active listings
_sources.airroi_comps_4bd_plus: n=15: median occ 30% / ADR $374 / rev $46,012; top well-run 4bd: 58-71% occ, ADR $344-374, rev $90-102k
_sources.note: Market-average revenue ($28k) mixes all sizes (mostly 1-2br); a 4bd commands the higher per-property figures above.

property.market: Higgins, District of Belconnen, ACT, Australia

financing._note: No mortgage supplied -> all-cash; cash-on-cash == net yield. Provide loan details to model leverage.

conservative.basis: AirROI p25 — first-year ramp / average-to-weak management

base.basis: AirROI p50 median for this property — competently run

leverage.interest_rate_source: ASSUMPTION — typical AU investor variable rate; edit to your actual

tax.marginal_rate_note: 39% = 37% bracket ($135k-190k taxable) + 2% Medicare levy (2025-26). Edit to your bracket.
tax.depreciation_note: STR ≈ Div-40 decline on the new $30k furnishings/fit-out (claimable because bought new); LTR minimal — the ~1970s house likely predates the post-15-Sep-1987 capital-works (Div 43) rule, so little/no building depreciation. Confirm with a quantity surveyor's schedule + your accountant.
tax.negative_gearing_note: You already own the property, so you are grandfathered under the negative-gearing changes announced 12 May 2026 (abolition from 1 Jul 2027 applies to established dwellings bought after that date). Net rental losses can offset other income at your marginal rate.

capital_growth_source: ASSUMPTION — Belconnen ~3.2% 5-yr CAGR (htag/estait 2026); long-run ACT house growth. IDENTICAL for STR vs LTR (same house), so it is common to both, not a differentiator.
tax_disclaimer: Indicative only, not tax advice. Australian property tax is fact-specific (main-residence history, holiday-home 'main use' test, land tax, GST is input-taxed for residential). Confirm with a registered tax agent before deciding.
